raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "submit"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "the heating assistance application"
  role destination "the town hall in Năsăud"
  role time "November"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "receive"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "anything"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@a1 assumed
  relation "be cold"
  role location "the user's house"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@q query
  select ?t
  where match
    relation "receive a response"
    role subject "the user"
    role object "the heating assistance application"
    polarity affirmed
  end
